authority: Review evidence only. Not an acceptance/completion gate and not an executed integration qualification of evaluator designs.

method.arms: One agent/run per arm; identical 24 paired tasks, authored answers capped at180 whitespace words excluding paths.
method.judgment_basis: Compare task decisions and consequences against retained exact-release source, full upstream rustdoc operation/module records and actual retained fixture code/logs. Authored briefs are claims, not oracle. No scoring by length, vocabulary, file count, or newness.
method.reviewer_actions: Read both answers, tasks, relevant full upstream operation/module docs, retained source and probe code/logs. Checked receipt hashes. No compilation or runtime integration test executed by reviewer. No expected-answer implementation plan or parent discussion used as oracle.

labels.improves: At least one task-consequential discovery, contract or evidence distinction is added without offsetting material loss. Does not necessarily mean baseline decision was wrong.
labels.matches: Same useful decision or mixed small gains/losses; wording volume alone earns no improvement.
labels.regresses: Materially worse task decision, false contract or evidence claim.

result_summary.core_findings: Both arms make supported core choices for all24 tasks. Candidate gains are principally verified contracts replacing uncertainty, with one simpler dictionary conversion route and more precise source setup. No confirmed wrong task-specific candidate output was found. E01B loses bulk-helper discovery; E10B needs a stronger limit oracle.
result_summary.baseline_mistakes: No confirmed wrong core decision/result in baseline; explicitly uncertain correct inferences are not factual errors.
not_established: Generalized improvement outside these seeded tasks
Process RSS, cloud I/O or universal filter-performance guarantees

measurement.comparability: Both count nested exec_command calls including artifact validation and report wall time through response serialization; start sampling and exploratory work differ. These are descriptive run observations, not isolated retrieval benchmarks. Candidate used more counted commands and longer observed wall time in this one run.
measurement.context_note: Neither arm records end-to-end delivered/consumed context. Both report truncated outputs; pre-truncation token estimates and artifact byte size do not measure model context consumption.
measurement.retrieval_affordances: Baseline read compact API/model/topic/index material plus examples. Candidate had task routes, decision briefs, complete operation/module contracts, reference.py and retained receipts. This compares two reference packages with different affordances and evidence availability, not an isolated prose change.

execution_evidence.evaluator_designs: Both arms report no new compilation/runtime verification; all sketches and correctness oracles remain proposed.
execution_evidence.candidate_snapshot: Retained evaluation/candidate receipt finished2026-09-18T19:46:43.765180+00:00 and contains13 named tests. Candidate metadata correctly describes that snapshot.
execution_evidence.reviewed_current_receipt: Current receipt finished2026-09-18T20:07:44.181341+00:00 and contains15 tests; current log has7 Arrow+6 engine+1 IPC+1 Parquet passes. All8 receipt source hashes match reviewed files. This replaced a14-test receipt while review was running. Later controls are not attributed to the frozen candidate run.
execution_evidence.retained_scope: Actual fixture tests are real integration evidence for their narrow assertions. Inexact keeps every candidate; stream fixture collects outputs; sort test forces a1-byte error; listing is local. The frozen dictionary fixture tests hydration; a later IPC stream test checks one same-version representation roundtrip. Current Parquet byte counters measure in-memory ChunkReader requests, not network I/O or decoder CPU.
execution_evidence.current_source_hash_verification: All8 current receipt source hashes matched after final refresh.
execution_evidence.later_changes: Working reference has16 briefs/15 tests versus frozen candidate15 briefs/13 tests. Added coalesce and IPC controls and Parquet requested-byte observations are subsequent implementation evidence; coalesce is outside these24 pilot tasks.

limitations: One independent response run per arm, no repeats, crossover or model-variance estimate.
Tasks are seeded around known target capabilities and paired contrasts; they are not a held-out sample of arbitrary DataFusion/Arrow work.
Unequal retrieval affordances/context observations and a candidate evidence snapshot older than current receipts limit attribution.
Reviewer verifies selected consequential claims and exact APIs; absence of an issue in24 brief answers is not exhaustive library or consumer qualification.

consequential_corrections.change: Retain the verbatim upstream docs but add a clearly separated correction note next to the Exact route/contract: return only TRUE rows; link enum overview, full scan contract and residual-removal fixture. Do not silently rewrite upstream text.
consequential_corrections.why: E09A detected a real upstream sentence whose literal interpretation reverses correct filtering.

consequential_corrections.change: Separate final SQL LIMIT cardinality from scan at-least hint allowance. Use a scan-spy/direct fixture that asserts Some(limit) is received, preserves duplicates and counts qualifying rows; test deterministic ordered SQL separately and inspect whether sorting prevented pushdown.
consequential_corrections.why: E10B improves contract precision but its proposed exact-count/ORDER BY oracle can miss the path it is meant to verify.

dictionary.supports: Reconstruction from preserved typed keys and values; bounds/negative-key errors.

ipc_read.supports: Read IPC with fallible footer/endianness validation.

ipc_write.supports: Footer completion is an explicit fallible writer step.

stream.supports: Self-consuming collect/stream terminal APIs and documented cancellation on stream drop.

memory.supports: Budget is max_memory*memory_fraction with tracked GreedyMemoryPool; upstream explicitly disclaims enforcement in all cases; disk configuration.

memtable.supports: Partitioned RecordBatch input and at least one partition; vec![vec![]] empty-table recipe.

listing_schema.supports: Provided schema contains file columns only, excluding partition columns; possible per-file coercion.

listing_partitions.supports: Hive path-derived columns; nonconforming files ignored; partition fields absent from Parquet files.

parquet_format.supports: Built-in Parquet pruning configuration; does not prove actual skipped bytes.

session.supports: Object store URL-prefix registration; the SessionContext physical-expression method coerces/rewrites without simplification.

provider.supports: Projected schema order, conjunction and TRUE rows, filter-only input columns, at-least limit hint, filter/limit/projection order and no inexact pushed limit; ScanArgs wording is separately inconsistent.

pushdown_enum.selector: enum docs and variants Exact, Inexact, Unsupported
pushdown_enum.supports: Top-level enum says return passing rows; Exact variant contradictorily says omit only passing tuples; Inexact keeps residual.

simplifier.supports: Simplifier requires operator-appropriate input types; coercion is a separate operation.

parquet_selection.supports: Row groups precede selection; excluded groups do not count; selection precedes RowFilter; page-index-dependent efficiency.

parquet_filter.supports: Predicate columns must be decoded, TRUE-only mask of batch length; later projected columns can be decoded again.

arrow_probe.supports: Executed fixtures for mask nulls/metadata, take duplicates/nulls/bounds, cast options, null ordering, dictionary hydration, zero columns and batch nullability.

provider_probe.supports: Exact/Inexact fixture SQL equality, residual presence, predicate column projection and actual Some(2)/None scan limits; Inexact retains every candidate.

expr_probe.supports: Mixed integer SQL output Int64; direct simplification does not fold incompatible literal widths; coerce then simplify gives 3i64; Boolean+Int32 coerce fails.

stream_probe.supports: Fixture streaming/collect/cache equality and 1-byte pool sort resource error; stream is collected, so no bounded-consumer/RSS test.

listing_probe.supports: Local Parquet registration/query fixture; no cloud authentication or partition-pruning/I/O qualification.

parquet_probe.supports: Three groups of three: all-domain position7 and retained-domain position4 both yield7; different coordinate yields1. Current log measures local requested bytes only.

receipt.supports: Current receipt records15 named tests and command exit codes, not evaluation-run integration tests.

probe_log.selector: all assertion results; provider and sort stdout; Parquet requested-byte stdout
probe_log.supports: Current log contains7 Arrow,6 engine,1 IPC,1 Parquet passed tests; confirms narrow fixture assertions.

filter_cost.supports: Exploratory fixed-order warm-cache debug timing for one primitive fixture, two sizes and reuse1/20; no universal crossover.

ipc_probe_later.supports: Added after frozen candidate snapshot: same-version IPC stream roundtrip for one Int8/Utf8 dictionary including nulls verifies schema, type and ArrayData equality. Does not test cross-version file compatibility, unused/duplicate dictionary entries or reordering sidecar reconstruction.
